verdict.rationale: Synctera supports scheduled payments that customers can create and manage, which run on a schedule without manual action. Its Webhook API pushes platform events to integrators, who can build their own background automations on top. This is narrow, domain-specific scheduling plus event plumbing, not a general automation or agent capability. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or rule builder, documented autonomous or agentic background workflows, trigger-action configuration beyond payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
